I added `currency: str = "USD"` to `Config` in `ledger/config.py`. The existing tests pass (4 passed), and I didn't add a test for the new field.

I did not add an environment-variable override. `docs/DECISIONS.md` says settings are file-configurable only, because a stray `LEDGER_DB_PATH` once pointed production jobs at a test database. So "configurable the same way as the other settings" means `ledger.toml` only.
